p: A desktop screen shows a folder multiplying uncontrollably into dozens of copies, followed by papers overflowing from the screen onto a desk as a developer looks on in confusion. The ad concludes with an end screen showing artifactshare.com and the tagline 'One URL that updates'.
Avoid version chaos and endless duplicate files by using one single updating link for shared work.
